pre_test_commands.desc: Set static IP 192.168.102.3 on the DebugHost debug NIC
pre_test_commands.guest_run: $a = Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object { $_.MacAddress -like '*-EE-EE' }; Set-NetIPInterface -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -Dhcp Disabled; Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-NetIPAddress -Confirm:$false; New-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $a.ifIndex -IPAddress 192.168.102.3 -PrefixLength 24
